d: Following the 2026 Midterm Elections defeat, US President Donald Trump has accepted that the Iran War played a major role in shaping the minds of American voters. This admission came after Vice President JD Vance put a long post on social media calling out the war in Iran and America's ties with Israel. Meanwhile, Donald Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr. has backed Vance in a viral social media post. Elon Musk has quietly stopped posting about the Midterm elections.
